Short title and commencement

THE FOREST LAWS AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1962
THE FOREST LAWS AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1962
ORDINANCE No. X of 1962
[24th February, 1962]
As Ordinance to amend certain Forest Laws and to validate certain
duties previously levied and collected
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Forest Laws Amendment Ordinance, 1962.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 39, Act XVI of 1927

THE FOREST LAWS AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1962
THE FOREST LAWS AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1962
ORDINANCE No. X of 1962
[24th February, 1962]
As Ordinance to amend certain Forest Laws and to validate certain
duties previously levied and collected
2. Amendment of section 39, Act XVI of 1927. In the Forest Act,
1927, in section 39, XVI of 1927 :--
(a) in
sub-sections (1) and (2), for the words "Central Government" the
words "Provincial Government" shall be substituted ;
(b) in
sub-section (1), clause (b), after the word "Pakistan", the words
"or is transported from or to any place within Pakistan" shall be
added ; and
(c) sub-sections
(3) and (4) shall be omitted.

Amendment of N.W,F.P. Act VI of 1937

THE FOREST LAWS AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1962
THE FOREST LAWS AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1962
ORDINANCE No. X of 1962
[24th February, 1962]
As Ordinance to amend certain Forest Laws and to validate certain
duties previously levied and collected
3. Amendment of N.W,F.P. Act VI of 1937. In the North-West Frontier
Province Hazara Forest Act, 1936, in section 28, N.W.F.P. Act VI of 1937 :-
(a) for the
words "Central Government" the words "Provincial
Government" shall be substituted ; and
(b) sub-section
(2) shall be omitted.

Validation of duties purporting to be levied under section 39, act XVI of 1927

THE FOREST LAWS AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1962
THE FOREST LAWS AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 1962
ORDINANCE No. X of 1962
[24th February, 1962]
As Ordinance to amend certain Forest Laws and to validate certain
duties previously levied and collected
4. Validation of duties purporting to be levied under section 39, act
XVI of 1927. All duties levied or collected, or intended or purported to
have been levied or collected by a Provincial Government under section 39 of
the Forest Act, 1927, or under section 28 of the North-West Frontier Province
Hazara Forest Act, 1936, be fore the promulgation of this Ordinance shall be
deemed to have been validly levied and collected, XVI of 1927. N.W.F.P. Act VI
of 1937.
